entries.title: Daily news briefing
entries.author: Sample entry
entries.description: Pulls the top health informatics and AI stories each morning and formats them as a one-page briefing.
entries.prompt: You are my morning briefing editor. Search for the five most important health informatics and clinical AI stories from the last 24 hours. For each story, give a headline, a two-sentence summary, and one line on why it matters to a hospital informatics team. Format the result as a one-page HTML briefing.

entries.title: Patient education handout
entries.author: Sample entry
entries.description: Turns a clinical topic into a plain-language handout at a sixth-grade reading level.
entries.prompt: Write a one-page patient handout about [topic] at a sixth-grade reading level. Use five short sections with headings, avoid jargon, and end with three questions the patient can ask at their next visit.

entries.title: Screening gap dashboard
entries.author: Sample entry
entries.description: Builds a quick clinic-level dashboard from a de-identified screening export.
entries.prompt: Using the attached de-identified CSV, build a single-page HTML dashboard showing completion rates for each screening measure by clinic, with a bar chart and three summary tiles.

entries.title: Discharge summary template
entries.author: Sample entry
entries.description: Drafts a structured discharge summary template with bracketed placeholders.
entries.prompt: Create a discharge summary template with six sections. Use bracketed placeholders for every patient-specific detail and add a one-line instruction under each heading.
